1	/-

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechSectionContractibilityOne
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechSectionContractibilitySucc
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Contractibility of the concrete section Čech complex
    11	
    12	This file packages the degreewise contracting identities into a contracting homotopy.
    13	-/
    14	
    15	universe u
    16	
    17	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    18	
    19	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    20	
    21	open Scheme.Modules
    22	
    23	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    24	
    25	section ContractingHomotopy
    26	
    27	variable (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    28	variable (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
    29	
    30	/-- The coinductive step: given the previous homotopy condition, the corrected component
    31	`h_{n+2} ≫ (𝟙 - p₂₁ ≫ d)` satisfies the next one (pure preadditive algebra from `(In)`
    32	and `d ∘ d = 0`). -/
    33	private lemma cechSection_succ_step (n : ℕ)
    34	    {f : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1) ⟶ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X n}
    35	    {g : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2) ⟶ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1)}
    36	    (hp : 𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1)) =
    37	      f ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d n (n + 1) +
    38	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫ g) :
    39	    𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) =
    40	      g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) +
    41	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 2) (n + 3) ≫
    42	          (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1) ≫
    43	            (𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) -
    44	              g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2))) := by
    45	  have hIn := cechSection_comm_succ 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV n
    46	  have hsub : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) =
    47	      (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫ g ≫
    48	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) := by
    49	    have h₀ := congrArg (fun m => m ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2)) hp
    50	    simpa only [Category.id_comp, Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc,
    51	      HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, comp_zero, zero_add] using h₀
    52	  have hd1E : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫
    53	      (𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) -
    54	        g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2)) = 0 := by
    55	    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id, sub_eq_zero]
    56	    exact hsub
    57	  have hdb := eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr ((add_comm _ _).trans hIn.symm)
    58	  rw [← Category.assoc ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 2) (n + 3))
    59	    (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1)) _, hdb, Preadditive.sub_comp,
    60	    Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, hd1E, comp_zero, sub_zero]
    61	  abel
    62	
    63	end ContractingHomotopy
    64	
    65	set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
    66	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    67	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    68	-- Coinductive homotopy packaging has deeply nested dependent degree equalities.
    69	/-- The concrete augmented section Čech complex is contractible after choosing a cover member
    70	that contains `V`. -/
    71	noncomputable def cechSection_contractible (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀]
    72	    (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    73	    (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) :
    74	    Homotopy (𝟙 ((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
    75	      (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V))) 0 :=
    76	  -- The prepend-`i_fix` contracting homotopy on the augmented concrete section complex,
    77	  -- assembled by `Homotopy.mkCoinductive` from the explicit components (`π_{i_fix}` at the
    78	  -- augmentation node, prepend-`i_fix` in the Čech degrees) and the three contracting
    79	  -- identities (I0)/(I1)/(In) proved above via the dependent combinatorial engine.
    80	  Homotopy.mkCoinductive _
    81	    (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
    82	    ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_zero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
    83	    (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0)
    84	    ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_one 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
    85	    (fun n p =>
    86	      ⟨cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1) ≫
    87	          (𝟙 (((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
    88	              (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V)).X (n + 2)) -
    89	            p.2.1 ≫ ((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
    90	              (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V)).d (n + 1) (n + 2)), by
    91	        have hp := (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).symm.trans p.2.2
    92	        exact (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans
    93	          (cechSection_succ_step 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV n hp)⟩)
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

  lemma cechSection_comm_one :
      𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X 1) =
        cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1 +
          (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫ cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 := by
    let E := sectionCechProductAddEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0
    ext t
    apply E.injective
    funext σ
    refine Eq.symm ?_
    have hsplit : ConcreteCategory.hom
        (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1 +
          (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫ cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0) t
        = ConcreteCategory.hom (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫
            (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1) t +
          ConcreteCategory.hom ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫
            cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0) t := by
      rw [AddCommGrpCat.hom_add_apply]
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun y => E y σ) hsplit) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun y => y σ) (map_add E _ _)) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      (cechSectionHomotopyZero_comp_d_coord 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV t σ)
      (cechSectionD_comp_homotopyComp_zero_coord 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV t σ)) ?_
    refine Eq.trans (CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy_spec i_fix (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V)
      (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
      (fun {m} σ' y => cechSection_hu 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV σ' y)
      (fun {m} σ' k y => cechSection_hsh 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV σ' k y)
      (fun τ => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t τ) σ) ?_
    exact congrArg (fun y => E y σ) (ConcreteCategory.id_apply t).symm

  noncomputable def cechSection_contractible (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀]
      (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
      (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) :
      Homotopy (𝟙 (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V)) 0 := by
    let C := cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V
    -- The prepend-`i_fix` contracting homotopy on the augmented concrete section complex,
    -- assembled by `Homotopy.mkCoinductive` from the explicit components (`π_{i_fix}` at the
    -- augmentation node, prepend-`i_fix` in the Čech degrees) and the three contracting
    -- identities (I0)/(I1)/(In) proved above via the dependent combinatorial engine.
    exact Homotopy.mkCoinductive (𝟙 C)
      (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
      ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_zero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
      (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0)
      ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_one 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
      (fun n p =>
        ⟨cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1) ≫
            (𝟙 (C.X (n + 2)) - p.2.1 ≫ C.d (n + 1) (n + 2)), by
          have hp := (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).symm.trans p.2.2
          exact (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans
            (cechSection_succ_step 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV n hp)⟩)
